lyrics:
[Intro: male group chanting alone, then drums and bass]
Hubba-loo, hubba-loo-la
Hubba-loo, hubba-loo-la
Hubba-loo, hubba-loo-la
Hubba-loo, hubba-loo-la

[Verse 1: joyful tenor, galloping beat, chant continues underneath]
I can't sit still, it's in my shoes
You're the best kind of terrible news
Lips like cider and a laugh like rain
I'm in trouble and I can't complain

[Chorus: brass section, full voice, group answering]
Oh, I'm stuck on a good thing
Glued to a real thing
Nobody come and pull me free
I'm stuck on a good thing
Tied to the best thing
That ever went and happened to me

[Verse 2: joyful tenor, organ joins]
I had plans, I had a list
I had a calm that I haven't missed
You came along like a marching band
Now I'm clapping, and I don't understand

[Chorus: brass section, full voice, group answering]
Oh, I'm stuck on a good thing
Glued to a real thing
Nobody come and pull me free
I'm stuck on a good thing
Tied to the best thing
That ever went and happened to me

[Bridge: band drops to chant and handclaps]
Hubba-loo, hubba-loo-la
(All day long)
Hubba-loo, hubba-loo-la
(All night long)

[Final Chorus: key up a step, brass blazing, everyone]
Oh, I'm stuck on a good thing
Glued to a real thing
Nobody come and pull me free
I'm stuck on a good thing
Tied to the best thing
That ever went and happened to me

Hubba-loo, hubba-loo-la
